title: orechunkcrafter
description: craft your ore with some highly abundant cane
body:
welcome to ore chunk crafter 

Are you tired of constantly having to mine for resources? Well then look no more orechunkcrafter is here, with orechunkcrafter you can now craft your ore from ore-cane found around the overworld.

To get started First.
1. find ore cane
2. break ore cane and pick up ore chunk drops
3. Smelt ore chunk drop in furnace into raw material (blast furnace not supported)
4. smelt the raw material in a furnace
5. then use your newly aquired ingots!

Currently only supports iron ore more will be added later.

Ore cannot be grown and doesn't regrow if left with only bottom cane block.
